caveats: These are the license files of the upstream projects as published in the google/fonts repository. They were fetched, not transcribed; each states its own copyright line.
No icon font is bundled, and the package declares none: icons are inline SVG in assets/icons/icons.svg, so no additional font licence applies to them.
English and Vietnamese glyph coverage is checked. Other writing systems require separate coverage testing.
